entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: Finished furniture catalog items such as tables, dressers, beds, and desks, excluding individual component parts, raw materials, or accessories.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: Discrete physical parts, structural pieces, fasteners, hardware, or materials that make up a product, excluding complete finished catalog products or quality defects.

entity_types.name: Defect
entity_types.description: Physical flaws, material imperfections, manufacturing errors, damage, or operational failures observed in a product or component, excluding normal product wear or subjective aesthetic preferences.

fact_types.description: Identifies that a component belongs to the product reviewed in the document.
Identifies that a sub-component, fastener, or piece of hardware is part of a larger component.
Identifies that a specific component exhibits a physical flaw, material failure, or manufacturing defect.
Identifies that a finished product exhibits an overall defect, instability, or operational failure.
Identifies that a physical or manufacturing defect directly causes another defect, damage, or functional failure.
